summary: First testing run for GymOS Next.js foundation. Executed backend API smoke via curl (login/me/logout for gym admin, health) and comprehensive Playwright UI E2E covering all 11 required flows. All acceptance criteria pass. No blocking issues found.

issues: KPI/stat card labels are visually uppercased via CSS (e.g., 'TOTAL GYMS', 'TOTAL MEMBERS'); underlying text is correct — cosmetic note only, matches design system.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts (used in RevenueChart) emits noisy console warnings about defaultProps for XAxis/YAxis — non-blocking but should be upgraded/refactored to satisfy React 19 future compatibility.
Auth cookie verified httpOnly; JWT secret in env; brute-force lockout note honored during testing (did not hammer same email).
test_credentials: Gym Admin admin@ironpulse.in/GymAdmin@123; Super Admin owner@gymos.app/SuperAdmin@123
seed_data_creation: Used existing idempotent seed (Iron Pulse Fitness gym + 2 users). No test data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js app at external preview URL; /api/* is proxied by FastAPI on 8001 to Next on 3000. Auth cookie name gymos_session, httpOnly. Brute-force lockout = 5 fails per ip:email/15min; to reset: mongosh gym_saas 'db.loginattempts.deleteMany({})'. KPI/nav labels use CSS uppercase; assert against underlying text (title-case) in HTML, not visual inner_text if labels appear uppercase.
verified_flows: Login page renders with demo credentials hint
Gym admin login -> /dashboard shows 7/7 KPI cards + 9/9 sidebar items + gym name + mock banner
Super admin login -> /super-admin shows 5/5 stat cards + 3/3 nav items + Iron Pulse Fitness in Recent Gyms
Invalid credentials -> data-testid=login-error shows 'Invalid email or password', stays on /login
Role separation: gym admin -> /super-admin redirects to /dashboard; super admin -> /dashboard redirects to /super-admin
Theme toggle switches html class dark <-> light
User menu -> Logout returns to /login and clears session
Mobile viewport (390x844): mobile-nav-trigger visible; clicking opens sheet with nav items
/super-admin/subscriptions shows ACTIVE, PAST_DUE, SUSPENDED, CANCELLED breakdown + MRR (sample) card
